name: dumbbell alternate biceps curl v. 2
description: Curling one dumbbell at a time while standing. A classic way to build the biceps with a steady rhythm.
instructions: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward.
Keeping your elbow by your side, curl one dumbbell up toward your shoulder.
Squeeze at the top, then lower it under control.
Repeat with the other arm and keep alternating.
Avoid swinging your torso to lift the weight.
